reference_notes: 第41–55题对照2025、2026年全国一卷同题位。前者从搬家处理物件推断行动与人物态度，后者结合离乡前后理解家乡生活及词义。此处原创溪流清理叙事，以相同取景、桶中的鱼线和后一场活动串联跨段线索，考查 frame、wound、recover、ran 等词在具体语境中的用法。

第56–65题对照2025年围棋艺术展、2026年大集的文化说明语篇，以朱仙镇木版年画的门上习俗、套色工艺和现代数字用途独立组文，覆盖冠词、非谓语、谓语被动、名词数、介词、从句、词性转换及并列；年画技艺据祥符区人民政府，手机屏幕图像项目和作坊体验据河南政协网刊载的实地采访。https://www.xiangfuqu.gov.cn/kfsxfqwz/msyc/pc/content/content_1878635824010838016.html https://hnzx.gov.cn/2026/01-30/4361135.html
第66题对照2025年给外教写信提出报刊栏目选择、2026年就大学生活事项排序并说明理由。原创任务要求在两名志愿者和维持取餐效率的约束下推荐可行办法，并把建议落实为分工。
第67题对照2025年的家庭关系修复与2026年雪夜求助的跨段因果照应。原创故事以两处栽植地的光照差异、幼苗标记、交付照片和约定时间构成补救条件，两段首分别约束主动联络与等候中的现场后果。

questions.stem:
假定你是李华。下周来访的交换生将首次在你校食堂用午餐。负责接待的外教 Ms. Taylor 提出两种办法：在排队区入口提供图文菜单（picture menus），或由学生志愿者在取餐区分批口头介绍菜品。学校只能安排两名志愿者，且不能拖慢原有取餐队伍。请给 Ms. Taylor 写一封邮件，内容包括：
（1）推荐一种办法并说明理由；
（2）说明两名志愿者如何分工。
注意：
（1）写作词数应为80个左右；
（2）请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Ms. Taylor,
Yours,
Li Hua
questions.answer: 开放作答。推荐一种方案，说明其如何帮助交换生选餐并维持取餐效率，写清两名志愿者的分工。

questions.stem:
阅读上述材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。
注意：
（1）续写词数应为150个左右；
（2）请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
I picked up my phone again and asked Alfie to stay with me.
At 10:00, the residents at Maple Court were still waiting beside their empty beds.
questions.answer: 开放作答。第一段如实联系两处居民并协调核对幼苗，第二段落实补救和种植安排，交代叙述者与 Alfie 的关系变化。

en-cloze.text:

Our town newsletter asked me for "before" and "after" photos of a creek cleanup. To keep the two shots [41] ____, I marked where I stood on the bank. Plastic bags hung from low branches.

At noon a blue bucket sat in the middle of my [42] ____. I asked Mina, a volunteer, to move it. I'd [43] ____ it was just a tool she'd left out. She tipped it toward me. Inside were bits of fishing line, neatly [44] ____ around strips of cardboard.

I took the wide shot, then stepped closer to [48] ____ the line against Mina's dark glove. At home I nearly [49] ____ the extra photo since I'd been asked for two. Instead, I [50] ____ it with the other two and a note about the line. The editor [51] ____ them side by side in that week's issue.

The next Saturday a woman [52] ____ at our cleanup with a box of cardboard strips. "I thought you could use more of these," she said, holding up a copy of the newsletter. en-grammar.title: 语法填空
en-grammar.text:
阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
In Zhuxian Town, near Kaifeng in Henan Province, the New Year often arrives in pairs. One picture goes on the left side of a doorway, and [56] ____ other goes on the right. For many families, putting up the pictures is a way [57] ____ (welcome) the New Year and express their hopes for a peaceful home. With heavy black outlines and oversized heads, the figures are easy to recognize from the street, even before a visitor steps inside. The craft itself [58] ____ (add) to China's national list of intangible cultural heritage (非物质文化遗产) in 2006.

A single picture takes several wooden [59] ____ (block) to make. The key block, once [60] ____ (carve) by hand, prints the dark outlines. Other blocks add the colors. The difference [61] ____ a clean edge and a blurred one can come down to a tiny movement of the paper. The printer has to position the sheet exactly the same way for each color, [62] ____ takes considerable practice.

The digital heritage museum's collection includes photographs of these prints. Look [63] ____ (careful) at an enlarged image, and you can see how one color meets the next. A phone image shows [64] ____ the finished picture looks like. Whether people first see the figures on a door [65] ____ on a phone, they can watch each color fall into place at a workshop in Zhuxian Town.

en-continuation.title: 读后续写
en-continuation.text:
Our community garden was giving away young plants on Saturday. Inside our shed, the trays on the left were going to Maple Court, where the entrance got sun all afternoon. The trays on the right were for Beech Court, whose planting beds were in the shade. The two buildings stood at opposite ends of our block. At each one, residents had arranged to meet at 10:00 and plant together. Any plants left over would be offered to families to take home.

My cousin Alfie, who was twelve, had helped raise both sets of plants. He had pressed a wooden marker into the corner of each tray, with a little sun for Maple Court and a green leaf for Beech Court. As I was loading the cart, he suggested we check the markers. "Sun plants on the left," I said. "I know." I wanted to finish before the rain came back. I left one batch under the noticeboard at Maple Court and the other beside the gate at Beech Court.

When I got back to the shed, Alfie was sweeping water away from the door. "Mrs. Patel moved some of the trays while you were getting the cart," he said. "The rain was blowing in." I pulled out my phone. I'd sent each building a photo of its delivery. In one photo, under the Maple Court noticeboard, I could see a marker with a green leaf. In the other photo, there was a little sun. The shed clock read 9:52. I'd told the residents they could start as soon as the trays arrived.

Alfie leaned over to look at the photos. He didn't say anything about my being in such a hurry. He just put down the broom and waited.
